target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table, re-rating the bull case's 'to 5-year minimum' logic across all three cash/earnings multiples at 52.19 current price: P/E to 15.4x implies 61.35 (the evaluator's chosen basis); EV/EBITDA to its 5y min 13.1x (vs current 9.7x) implies ~70.49; P/FCF to its 5y min 21.9x (vs current 12.4x) implies ~92.18. target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bear.target_price_12m: net margin reverts from 16.2% TTM to the FY2022 trough of 11.7% at an unchanged 13.1x P/E (factsheet Quality table, income statement)

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Quality table: applying the bear case's 'revert to FY2022 trough' logic to each profitability metric at unchanged multiples gives divergent implied prices. Net margin (16.2% TTM -> 11.7% FY2022, ratio 0.722) implies 52.19x0.722=37.70 (the evaluator's chosen P/E basis); operating margin (22.8% TTM -> 15.4% FY2022, ratio 0.675) as an EV/EBITDA proxy implies ~35.25; FCF margin (16.8% TTM -> 6.7% FY2022, ratio 0.399) as a P/FCF proxy implies ~20.81. Half the spread (37.70-20.81)/2=8.45 relative to the 37.70 target = 0.224, rounded to 0.22.
